reason: I cannot risk paying for software that connects to our Google Drive until I have absolute proof that it cannot view or read our existing private client files. As a frugal two-person practice, I will only test the free pilot on dummy files first rather than locking into a ₹12,990 annual subscription.
objection: Will connecting my Google Drive give Docketra access to read all my firm's private files?
would_change_my_mind: Verifiable technical confirmation that Docketra's OAuth scope is strictly sandboxed to its own folder, plus seeing it actually automate my Saturday GST reconciliation during the free pilot.
